_comment: Copy to store.json (gitignored) in the skill root or in a work dir. Store-specific facts live ONLY here, never in SKILL.md / LEARNINGS.md / CASES.md. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_shop_domain: The myshopify domain (Admin API host). Preview links can use your public domain instead.
_public_domain: Customer-facing domain used for preview links: https://<public_domain>/products/<handle>?preview_theme_id=<id>
_brand_name: Used in the exit popup consent text and anywhere the page names the seller. Never the reference store's name.
_location_gid: Fulfillment location for delivery profiles. Discover: query { locations(first: 10) { nodes { id name isActive } } }
_online_store_publication_gid: Discover: query { publications(first: 20) { nodes { id name } } } -> the one named 'Online Store'.
_insurance_product_handle: Optional. Handle of the hidden 'Shipping Insurance' product (stage 9). Blank = no insurance row in the cart drawer.
_insurance_percent: Insurance price per item = round(percent x item price). One insurance variant per price point.
_klaviyo_public_key: Optional. Klaviyo public site ID (company_id) for the exit popup. Public value, not a secret API key. Never put private API keys in this file.
_theme_name_prefix: Duplicated draft themes are named '<prefix> <product> v<N> <change>' so they are easy to find and clean up.
_prefix: File-name prefix for per-clone theme files (sections/<prefix>-<slug>.liquid, snippets, template suffix). Shared files (ppc-cart-drawer, ppc-related, ppc-exit-popup, ppc-announcement-bar) keep 'ppc'. Change only if 'ppc-' collides with existing theme files; the announcement bar checks template.suffix contains 'ppc-'.
_volume_discount_exclusion_tag: Optional. If the store already runs a store-wide quantity discount on a smart collection, the tag that excludes a product from it (so it does not override the clone's own tiers).
_product_tag: Tag on every cloned product - used to list them (e.g. for related products) and to clean up later.
